pattern_id.description: Unique identifier for this pattern (e.g., mika-instinct-001)

pattern_description.description: Human-readable description of what this pattern is

source_decisions.description: List of decision record IDs that established this pattern

occurrence_count.description: How many times this pattern has been observed

outcome_scores.description: Array of outcome scores (0-1) for each occurrence

promoted_to_tier1.description: Whether this pattern has been promoted to Tier 1 autonomous rule

promotion_blocked_reason.description: If not promoted, reason blocking promotion (e.g., low outcome score, needs more evidence)
